preconditions.description: L and R are within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The number of blocks n is greater than zero.
Each level number t_i in the sequence S is non-negative.
Each count c_i in the sequence C is at least one.
The sum of counts C equals the total number of segments m.

postconditions.expression: all(t_i != t_i+1 for i in range(len(S)-1))
postconditions.description: Consecutive level numbers in S are different.
The first segment starts at L and the last segment ends at R.

postconditions.expression: all(l_i+1 == r_i for i in range(m-1))
postconditions.description: Each segment is contiguous with the next.

postconditions.expression: all([l_i, r_i] in square_ten_tree_levels for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each segment [l_i, r_i] belongs to some level of the square-ten tree.
